name: dirty_frag_groundtruth
description: Single-case regression benchmark: synthesize the attack chain for CVE-2026-43284 (Dirty Frag) and compare to the hand-validated ground truth in chains/CVE-2026-43284.json. The expected technique sequence is T1078 -> T1068 -> T1548.003 -> T1014.

variables.cve_description: Memory-fragmentation race in the Linux kernel that allows an unprivileged local user to escalate to root by colliding two adjacent page allocations during a partial write. Affects kernels 6.6.x, 6.7.x, 6.8.x. CISA KEV listed.
